[02/09/2026, 09:30] Wangari: Hi, is the LG 20 litre microwave still available?
[02/09/2026, 09:34] Kiplagat: Yes, solo microwave, works perfectly. 7,500
[02/09/2026, 09:36] Wangari: Ok I'll take it at 7,500
[02/09/2026, 09:37] Wangari: Please send it to Thika by G4S
[02/09/2026, 09:39] Kiplagat: Ok, I can drop it at G4S tomorrow
[02/09/2026, 10:15] Wangari: Actually, change of plan. I'll be in town on Saturday, I'll just come pick it up myself. Don't send it
[02/09/2026, 10:18] Kiplagat: No problem, cancel G4S. Come Saturday, I'm at Tom Mboya street
[02/09/2026, 10:19] Wangari: Great, Saturday then
notes: Relative date: delivery method changes midway from G4S courier to buyer pickup; gold is the final pickup on 'Saturday' from Wed 2 Sep = 2026-09-05.
